data.one_liner: Lightweight client‑side fuzzy search using Levenshtein distance
data.what_it_does: Woozy provides a simple API to add entries and search them with fuzzy matching. It returns ranked results with optional associated values and limits. The library is null‑safe and works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need fast, in‑memory fuzzy search without external services
You want to associate arbitrary data with search terms
You need a small dependency footprint
avoid_when: You require server‑side search or advanced ranking algorithms
You need full text search with indexing or persistence
strengths: Very small API, no build_runner or codegen
Supports associated values and result limits
weaknesses: Only Levenshtein distance, no other scoring methods
No persistence or indexing, performance degrades with very large datasets
